tasks.title: RM11 application adoption and exact-version evaluation
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Validate and atomically adopt an executable version through the existing host path. Capture one immutable version per invocation, report requested/applied/rejected status, and enforce same-scope exact history, current host admission and retained failure behavior. Cover RM11-AC18 and AC20.
tasks.validation: Use native host/provider cases for concurrent adoption, in-flight version capture, distinct instances, accepted older exact version with newer active, incompatible/unavailable/foreign exact reference, and bootstrap/recovery/outage.
